chapter: Violinists, Jimmy Noon and Decatur Street
title: Jimmy Noon as a neighbour
summary: Jimmy Noon lived next door about fifty years earlier and played clarinet and then saxophone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Did you ever know Jimmy Noon?
Jimmy Noon used to live next little miles on the woman's track. The saxophone player.

Jimmy Noon used to live next little miles on the man's track. I was living, I was living, I was living, I was living, eight, let's see, eight, I was living in the 800 block. That's between Sinai and the Dupin.
And he was right there, huh?
Right next door to me. That's over 20 years ago. Jimmy Noon was a player.
Oh, 50 years ago. Huh? It'd be 50 years ago, I bet, Jimmy Noon, huh?
He used to live right next to him at my house on the wrong street.
And Paul Donneray used to live next to him at my house, too.
Did Jimmy Noon play clarinet when you knew him?
Yeah. Then he wound up playing saxophone.
Oh, he did? Yeah. I didn't know he ever stooped that long. He was such a good clarinet player. He was a good clarinet player.
He made us a lot of fellas, and I know, you know.
Did Jimmy Noon have his own band, or did he play with somebody?
